name: Fibonacci
code:
# Fibonacci (RISC-V assembly, iterative)
# fib(0) = 0, fib(1) = 1, fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2)
#
# a0 = n
# t0 = fib(i), t1 = fib(i+1)

    li a0, 0xA          # n = 10
    li t0, 0x0          # fib(0) = 0
    li t1, 0x1          # fib(1) = 1
    li t2, 0x0          # i = 0

loop:
    bge t2, a0, done          # i >= n -> finished
    add t3, t0, t1            # next = fib(i) + fib(i+1)
    mv  t0, t1                # fib(i)   = fib(i+1)
    mv  t1, t3                # fib(i+1) = next
    addi t2, t2, 0x1          # i++
    j loop

done:
    mv a0, t0                 # a0 = fib(10) = 0x37 = 55
